section: New Mexico property tax: state rules
label: Levied by
value: Counties, municipalities, school districts, special districts, institutions of higher education, plus a state debt service levy
note: Rates are certified each year by the Department of Finance and Administration, Local Government Division.
source_title: New Mexico Department of Finance and Administration: Overview of Property Tax Certification Process, effective July 28, 2026

section: New Mexico property tax: state rules
label: State oversight
value: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department, Property Tax Division
note: Monitors county assessors and values state-assessed property; DFA Local Government Division certifies tax rates.
source_title: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department: Property Tax Overview

section: New Mexico property tax: state rules
label: Constitutional limit on operating rates
value: 20 mills ($20 per $1,000 of net taxable value): counties up to $11.85, municipalities up to $7.65, school districts up to $0.50
note: Limit on general operating levies without voter approval; voter-approved and debt levies are on top.
source_title: New Mexico Department of Finance and Administration: Overview of Property Tax Certification Process, effective July 28, 2026

section: New Mexico real estate transfer tax: figures under review
label: State real estate transfer tax
value: None: New Mexico has no real estate transfer tax
note: Bills to create one (e.g. a 2021 Real Estate Transfer Tax Act proposal) were introduced; no current official statement could be read.
source_title: New Mexico Legislative Finance Committee: Fiscal impact report, SB 160 (2008)
